# Section load request

Requests a section load; USTART1 calls it for section 3, which then crosses to CPU1.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60042063` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

The request goes to CPU1, whose dispatch task runs the queued loader 0x600421e1. Completion means bytes arrived, not that section initialisers ran.
